spans.s: 2 प॑द् m. (adj. —˚ f. पद् or पदी) foot, step, quarter.
(पा॑द्) m. (adj. —˚ f. पद् or पदी) foot, step, quarter.
पदगति f. manner of going, gait.
पदज्ञा a. knowing (places), wise.
पदनी॑ a. following the steps of (gen.).

पदनी॑य a. to be investigated;
 abstr. ˚त्व† n.
पदन्यास m. putting down the feet, tread, footmark.

पादन्यास m. placing the feet or throwing the rays,
step, footprint.

पद॑पङ्क्ति f. = seq.;
 N. of a metre.
पदपद्धति f. a row of footsteps.
पादपद्धति f. line of footsteps, track.

पदपाठ m. the word-recitation (of the Veda, cf.
क्रम˚ & संहितापाठ).
पदपूरण a. & n. filling out a verse.
पादपूरण a. & n. filling out a verse.
पदबन्ध m. poem (lit. = seq.).
पादबन्ध m. fetter for the feet.

पदरचना f. arrangement of words, literary
composition.
पदवी॑य n. footstep, vestige.
पदशब्द m. the sound of footsteps.*
पदशस् adv. step by step or word by word.
पादशस् adv. foot by foot or by a fourth.
पदश्रेणि f. = पद॑पङ्क्ति.
पदाक्रान्त a. following at one's heels.*
पदाङ्क m. footmark.

पदाति a. going on foot;
 m. pedestrian, foot-soldier.
पदादि m. the beginning of a verse or word.
पदान्त m. the end of a verse or word.

पादान्त m. the extremity of the foot or the end of a
verse.
1 पदान्तर n. a step's interval.
2 पदान्तर n. another word.
पादान्तर n. interval or distance of a foot.

पद्म m. n. lotus, esp. the flower (which closes at
evening), fig. an army arrayed in the form of a lotus or a cert. posture
of the body in religious meditation;
 one of the treasures of Kubera, a
cert. high number (1000 billions).
पद्मक m. n. = prec., m. N. of a tree & a man.
1 पद्मगर्भ m. the interior or calyx of a lotus.
पद्मगृहा f. E. of Lakṣmī (lit. the lotus-housed).
पद्मज m. E. of Brahman (cf. 2 पद्मगर्भ).
पद्मता f. abstr. to पद्म.
पद्मदलेक्षण a. lotus (leaf-) eyed.
पद्मनाभ m. E. of Viṣṇu (the lotus-naveled).
पद्मपाणि m. E. of Brahman (the lotus-handed).
पद्मपुर n. N. of a town.
पद्मपुराण n. T. of a Purāṇa.
पद्मभव m. = पद्मज.
पद्मभू m. = पद्मज.
पद्ममय f. ई made or consisting of lotus.
पद्मयोनि m. = पद्मज.
पद्मरति f. a woman's name.
पद्मराग m. a ruby (lotus-coloured).
पद्मवर्चस् a. lotus-coloured.
पद्म˚वर्ण a. lotus-coloured.
पद्मव्याकोश a. lotus-blossom or flower.
पद्मशस् adv. by thousands of billions.
पद्मषण्ड n. a group of lotuses.
पद्मसंभव m. = पद्मज.
पद्मसरस् n. lotus-lake.
पद्माकर m. lotus group or pond.

पद्माक्ष f. ई lotus-eyed;
 m. E. of Viṣṇu.
पद्मादित्व n. the being a lotus-flower etc.
पद्मालय m. E. of Brahman (the lotus-housed).
पद्मावती f. = पद्मवती.
1 पद्मासन n. lotus-seat.
2 पद्मासन m. E. of Brahman (the lotus-seated).
पद्मिनीखण्ड n. a multitude of lotuses.
पद्मिनीपत्त्र n. a lotus-leaf.
पद्मोद्भव m. = पद्मज.
पद्यमय a. consisting of verses.
पद्र m. a village.

पद्व॑न्त् a. having feet, running;
 n. such an animal.

पादक॑ s. little foot;
 a. —˚ foot i.g. (f. ˚दिका).
*पादकटक m. n. foot-ring, anklet.
पादगृ॑ह्य (ger.) seizing one's feet.

पादग्रहण n. clasping a person's feet (as a
reverential salutation).
पादचार a. going on foot.
पाद˚चारिन् a. going on foot.
पादजल n. water for washing the feet.
पादतल n. the sole of the foot.
पादत्र n. a shoe (foot-protecting).
पाद˚त्राण n. a shoe (foot-protecting).
पादधावन n. washing the feet.
पादनख m. a toe-nail.
पादप m. plant, tree (drinking with the foot or root).
पादपतन n. falling at another's feet, prostration.
पादपद्म m. a lotus (like) foot.

पादपीठ^1 n. foot-stool.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: cf. CCS, MW, PW, etc..
पादप्रक्षालन n. washing the feet.
पादप्रहार m. a kick (foot-blow).
पादभट m. foot-soldier.
पादभाग m. fourth part, quarter.
पादरजस् n. the dust of the feet.

पादलग्न a. sticking in the foot or lying at one's
feet.
पा॑दवन्त् a. having feet.

पादवन्दन n. respectful salutation (lit. saluting
the feet).
पादशौच n. cleaning the feet.
पादाग्र n. point of the foot, toe.
पादाघात m. a kick (blow with the feet).
*पादाङ्गद n. foot-ring, anklet.
पादाङ्गुलि f. toe (foot-finger).
पादाङ्गु˚ली f. toe (foot-finger).
पादाङ्गुष्ठ m. the great toe (foot-thumb).
पादात m. foot-soldier, foot-man.
पादाभिवन्दन n. = पादवन्दन.
पादाभि˚वादन n. = पादवन्दन.
पादार्ध n. half a quarter or half a stanza.
पादार्पण n. setting down the feet, stepping upon.
पादावनेजन f. ई used for washing the feet.

पादावसेचन n. water for washing the feet or in
which the feet have been washed.
पादाहति f. = पादाघात.

पादिन् a. = पादवन्त्;
 also being entitled to one fourth.

पादु॑ m. foot, step;
 place.
पादू f. the same.
पादुक shoe, slipper.
पादु˚का f. shoe, slipper.
पादून a. = पादोन.
पादोदक n. water for washing the feet.
पादोन a. less by one fourth.
